questions.stem:
—_____ you ever _____ to the Shenzhen Science Museum?
—Yes, I _____. I _____ there with my classmates last weekend.
options: C. Have; gone; have; have been
questions.explanation: 选B。第一空根据ever可知用现在完成时have been to（表示去过已回）；回答也用现在完成时have；最后一空有last weekend明确过去时间状语，用一般过去时went。A选项第一空用Did则ever位置不对且语义不符；C选项have gone to表示去了未回，与回答矛盾；D选项时态全错。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy _____ is playing basketball over there is the monitor of Class 3. The book _____ he is reading is about environmental protection.
questions.explanation: 选B。第一空先行词the boy指人，关系代词用who；第二空先行词the book指物，关系代词用which。口诀：人用who物用which，that通用不挑剔。A选项两空反了；C选项第一空可用that但第二空指物不能用who；D选项第二空that虽然可用，但选项B更符合'人用who物用which'的规范教学。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Many old buildings in Shenzhen _____ down last year to make room for new schools.
questions.explanation: 选A。主语buildings与pull down是被动关系（被拆除），时间状语last year表明用一般过去时的被动语态were pulled。B选项是主动语态；C选项是一般现在时被动，时态不符；D选项主动且时态错误。被动语态结构：be + done，注意时态变化。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Could you tell me _____?
—Sure. He will come back as soon as he finishes his work in Guangzhou.
options: A. when will your father come back
B. when your father will come back
C. when your father came back
D. when did your father come back
questions.explanation: 选B。宾语从句必须用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除A和D；根据答句He will come back可知用一般将来时，排除C（过去时）。宾语从句三注意：时态呼应、陈述语序、连接词选择。本题考查语序和时态，难度较大。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—How do you usually _____ your weekends?
—I usually stay at home and read books. Sometimes I play basketball with friends.
questions.explanation: 选C。spend time表示'度过时间'，主语是人。take通常用it takes sb time to do sth；cost主语是物，指花费金钱；pay通常与for搭配指付款。固定搭配：spend weekends/holidays表示'过周末/假期'。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is _____ (possible) for humans to live on Mars without special equipment because there is no air there.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据句意'没有特殊装备人类在火星生活是不可能的'，需要形容词impossible（不可能的）。前缀im-表示否定，接在p开头形容词前。A是副词；C意思相反；D是名词。结构：It is + adj. + for sb to do sth。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should _____ the lights when we leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 选B。turn off表示'关闭'，符合句意'离开教室关灯省电'。turn on打开；turn up调大（音量）；turn down调小/拒绝。动词短语辨析要结合语境，save electricity提示是'关'灯。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a Green Campus Project. The aim was to help students understand the importance of protecting the environment in daily life. All the students were encouraged to take part in different activities.

First, we set up recycling boxes in every classroom. We collected waste paper, plastic bottles and old books. At first, some students thought it was troublesome (麻烦的) to separate the rubbish. But when they learned that these materials could be reused to make new products, they became more active. Every Friday afternoon, volunteers would carry the recyclable items to a local recycling center.

Besides recycling, we also worked on saving energy. We made sure to turn off the lights and computers before leaving the classrooms. The teachers told us that even small actions could make a big difference to our planet. By the end of the month, we found that our school had saved about 20% more electricity than before.

Through this project, we not only learned practical skills but also realized that everyone can contribute to environmental protection. It was a meaningful experience for all of us.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据上文'参加不同的...'以及下文提到的recycling boxes, saving energy等具体活动，可知此处指activities（活动）。classes班级/课程；meetings会议；exams考试，均不符合上下文语境。完形填空要注意词汇复现和上下文逻辑。

questions.group_passage:
Do you feel stressed when you have too much homework and no time for your hobbies? Many middle school students in Shenzhen face this problem. However, Li Wei, a 14-year-old student from Futian, has found a good way to balance his study and interests.

Li Wei loves playing the guitar. He practices every day, but he never lets it affect his schoolwork. "The key is time management," he says. "I make a schedule every Sunday evening for the whole week. I write down all my homework and deadlines first. Then I block out time for guitar practice."

His method works well. Li Wei not only gets good grades but also won the second prize in a city guitar competition last month. He suggests that students should use small pieces of time wisely. "For example, you can review English words while waiting for the bus, or do some reading before bedtime. This way, you can save big blocks of time for your hobbies."

However, Li Wei also warns that hobbies should not become another source of stress. "If you feel too tired, it's okay to skip practice for a day. The most important thing is to enjoy both studying and your hobbies," he adds.

Many of his classmates have started to follow his advice. They find that having hobbies actually helps them study better because they feel happier and more relaxed.
questions.stem: What does Li Wei do every Sunday evening?
options: A. He plays the guitar for the whole evening.
B. He makes a plan for the coming week.
C. He takes part in guitar competitions.
D. He reviews all his school subjects.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据文章第二段第三句'I make a schedule every Sunday evening for the whole week'（我每周日晚上制定整周的时间表），schedule与plan同义。A选项弹吉他整晚与原文'never lets it affect schoolwork'矛盾；C选项参加竞赛是偶尔行为；D选项复习所有科目未提及。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

options: A. Li Wei spends more time on guitar than on study.
B. All students in Li Wei's class have won prizes.
C. Having proper hobbies may help improve study efficiency.

options: A. How to Win a Guitar Competition

questions.group_passage:
Joining a school club is a great way to enrich your middle school life. However, many students feel nervous when they first enter a club. Here are some tips to help you.

(17)_____ First, find out what the club does and what activities they offer. You can ask senior students or check the club's online page. Knowing this helps you prepare mentally.

(18)_____ Don't be afraid to introduce yourself to other members. A simple "Hello, I'm new here" is enough to start a conversation. Remember that everyone was new once.

(19)_____ Clubs usually meet regularly, so try to attend every activity. If you keep showing up, you will gradually build relationships with other members and feel more comfortable.

(20)_____ Whether it's a sports competition or an art exhibition, take part actively. This not only improves your skills but also helps you make friends with similar interests.
options: A. However, don't push yourself too hard.
B. Then, be active in club activities.
C. First, do some research before joining.
D. Next, be friendly and open to others.
questions.explanation: 选C。本段主要讲加入前先了解俱乐部情况（find out what the club does），与C选项'先做些调查'对应。注意段落中的First提示这是第一条建议，与C选项的First呼应。干扰项D的Next表示接下来，E的Finally表示最后，均不符合此处顺序。
questions.label: 短文填空
